statement: ByteDance closed a $29.6 billion syndicated loan for data-center spending, upsized from a $20 billion target after orders topped $30 billion, and priced at 68 basis points over SOFR versus 85 basis points on its previous facility.
why: Cheaper pricing on a much larger book shows lenders are still willing to fund AI build-outs on easier terms, which loosens the financing constraint on large non-hyperscaler buyers of compute.

impact.mechanism: Lower spreads and heavy oversubscription cut the cost of capital for data-center construction, letting marginal buyers commit to more compute capacity.

evidence.excerpt: Pricing: 68 basis points over SOFR, down from 85 basis points on the previous facility, reflecting strong lender demand.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; loan terms are reported rather than drawn from a filing.
